name: platty-mcp
description: Platty MCP search skills (orchestrator, docs and code evidence collectors, impact investigator, claim audit), memory lifecycle routing, and client setup for configured context servers; SDD and Figma skills are explicit-only (invoke by exact name).

interface.shortDescription: Platty MCP search: docs + code evidence, answers in screen words
interface.longDescription: Use the platty-mcp-search skill to answer project questions through read-only Platty MCP context: it scopes the question to EPICs and routes, dispatches the platty-mcp-doc-search and platty-mcp-code-search collectors, audits their claim ledgers, and answers non-developer business teams in the words they see on screen. platty-mcp-memory routes explicit memory lifecycle requests; platty-mcp-client-setup registers an existing MCP endpoint. No local CLI lifecycle commands. The SDD and Figma skills (platty-mcp-sdd-spec, platty-mcp-sdd-design, platty-mcp-sdd-spec-from-figma, platty-mcp-sdd-design-with-figma, platty-mcp-figma-design-sync) and the legacy ladders (using-platty-mcp, platty-mcp-retrieval, platty-mcp-code-qa, platty-mcp-impact-analysis) are explicit-only: invoke them by exact name; they never auto-trigger on a question.
defaultPrompt: Search and answer from my configured Platty MCP context.
Explain what happens on this screen for a non-developer, using the platty-mcp-search skill.
